feature.line: Draw and paint like you would on paper. Free, made by the KDE community.

jobs.name: Edit photos
jobs.advice: Coming from Photoshop? GIMP. Lightroom? darktable. A quick crop or fix? Pinta.

jobs.name: Draw
jobs.advice: Painting and sketching? Krita. Logos and drawings that scale? Inkscape.

jobs.name: Write
jobs.advice: Documents and spreadsheets? LibreOffice. Notes that link to each other? Obsidian.

jobs.name: Talk to people
jobs.advice: Private messages? Signal. Groups and channels? Telegram. Friends and games? Discord. Mail? Thunderbird.

jobs.name: Watch and listen
jobs.advice: Plays anything: VLC. Minimal and fast: mpv. Music streaming: Spotify.

jobs.name: Edit videos
jobs.advice: Effects, titles and many tracks? Kdenlive. A simpler timeline? Shotcut.

jobs.name: Record the screen
jobs.advice: Scenes, streaming and recording? OBS Studio. One-click recording? Kooha.

jobs.name: Make in 3D
jobs.advice: Models, animation and film? Blender. Parts to print or build? FreeCAD.

jobs.name: Make music
jobs.advice: Record and cut audio? Audacity. A full studio? Ardour. Beats and synths? LMMS.

jobs.name: Code
jobs.advice: The editor most people use: VS Code. Fast and modern: Zed.

jobs.name: Play games
jobs.advice: Your Steam library? Steam. Epic and GOG? Heroic. Minecraft? Prism Launcher.

jobs.name: Browse the web
jobs.advice: Calm and focused: Zen. The classic: Firefox. Built-in blocking: Brave.
